# ValexHub

> ValexHub provides custom business software and management systems for Nigerian SMEs — including schools, hotels, pharmacies, restaurants, and property managers.

## About

ValexHub is a Nigerian SaaS platform that deploys ready-made and custom-built business management software for Nigerian small and medium-sized enterprises. Each deployment runs on dedicated cloud infrastructure via Coolify and can be connected to a custom domain.

Key differentiators:
- Pre-configured for the Nigerian business context: Naira payments, Paystack integration, WAT timezone, WhatsApp notifications
- Offline-capable systems for environments with unreliable internet
- 5–10 business day deployment for pre-built systems; ~7 weeks for fully custom software
- Local WhatsApp, phone, and remote-access support
- Monthly subscription pricing denominated in Naira
- Data ownership — clients retain full access to their data

## Products

Pre-built systems available for immediate deployment:

- **School Management System** — student records, fee collection, timetables, attendance, parent portal
- **Hotel Management System** — room booking, guest management, front desk operations, billing
- **Pharmacy POS** — inventory management, dispensing records, sales tracking, expiry alerts
- **Restaurant Management** — table management, order taking, kitchen display, sales reports
- **Property Management System** — tenant management, rent collection, maintenance requests, lease tracking
- **Real Estate CRM** — property listings, lead management, viewing schedules, document storage

## Services

- Pre-built solution deployment, configuration, and branding
- Custom software development (bespoke systems built to exact business requirements)
- Custom domain registration and DNS setup
- Staff training and onboarding (included with every deployment)
- Ongoing technical support and managed hosting

## Affiliate Program

ValexHub operates an affiliate program for business consultants, IT professionals, and entrepreneurs who refer clients.

- Earn up to 30% recurring monthly commission per referred client
- Multi-tier structure: earn from referrals made by your referrals
- Monthly payouts via Nigerian bank transfer
- Dedicated affiliate dashboard with referral link, commission ledger, and payout requests
- Sign up at: https://valexhub.com/register

## Billing

- One-time setup fee covers installation, customisation, data migration, and training
- Monthly subscription covers hosting, software updates, and ongoing support
- All payments accepted in Naira via Paystack
- Cancel anytime — data exported and handed over with no penalty
